findings.description: In the sunlit wide shot, the single waitress who had just stood up from a stool is suddenly shown twice: one copy wiping the counter behind it near the kitchen pass-through (screen-left background) and another in the foreground lunging right along the counter. Both copies persist on the server side through 01:53-01:56 before merging into one figure by 01:57.

findings.invariant_violated: body passing through fixed geometry / side-of-anchor change without crossing
findings.description: At 01:50-01:51 the waitress is on the customer side (sitting, then standing on the stool side leaning over the counter). By 01:52 her leg is drawn over the counter's front panel while her torso is beyond the counter top, and by 01:53 she stands on the server side with her back to camera. This happens mid-counter, with no counter end or gap, so she passes through the counter.

findings.invariant_violated: opposite side of anchor without visible crossing / overlapping counter
findings.description: At 01:20 the waitress stands on the server side behind the counter facing the seated man. One second later (01:21-01:26) she is on the customer side right beside him, sitting with no stool, wedged between the man and the counter edge, her legs overlapping the counter front. There is no visible trip around the counter and no plausible space to sit there. The following CU (01:26.8) keeps her on the customer side.

findings.invariant_violated: body overlapping fixed geometry (seated through counter)
findings.description: After the cut back to the front wide, the man is no longer on a stool on the customer side facing the counter, as he was in shot 3 (00:24-00:27). Instead he faces the camera, to the right of the stool row. His torso is beyond the counter top edge while his jeans appear where the counter's front panel should be, so he looks seated inside or through the counter body. The waitress has also vanished from the server side.
